tab.title: UPS
tab.error: Could not read the UPS on this host.
tab.disabled: UPS Manager is turned off for this host. Turn it on in the host settings.
tab.refreshHint: Refreshes only while Overview is visible. The UPS may update more slowly. Background polling and stored samples remain at 30 seconds.

overview.estimatedLoadHint: Output watts / {{watts}} W rated. {{method}}. Sensor accuracy unverified; not CPU utilization or AC wall consumption.

electrical.dcHint: Confirm the electrical domain before calculating watts from voltage and current. This does not change any UPS setting. Sensor accuracy must be checked independently.
electrical.calculated: Calculated DC power - sensor accuracy unverified
electrical.dcDisclaimer: Calculated DC output power estimates the UPS load, not AC wall consumption. It is not necessarily one host's consumption. Validate current readings before relying on power or energy estimates.

energy.estimated: Estimated from scheduled samples; not a hardware meter
energy.incomplete: Incomplete data; missing time is not estimated
energy.scope: UPS output, not AC wall energy. Period totals span the listed tracking epochs; do not treat different epochs as one physical meter.
energy.resolution: Nominal chart segment: {{seconds}} seconds; gaps remain separate. Hover points for absolute time and timezone.
energy.empty: Energy tracking needs two valid scheduled power readings. Unknown watts remain unavailable, not zero.
energy.samples: Accessible samples and cumulative observed energy
energy.tableHelp: Only observed energy is summed. Missing intervals are not filled. Cumulative values span the listed epochs.
energy.chartHelp: Time-proportional data. Missing intervals and changes of tracking epoch are not connected. Sampled peaks are not hardware peak measurements. An accessible data table follows the charts.
energy.correlationBlocked: CPU/memory correlation is unavailable: Host Metrics needs a public, authorized snapshot service with measurement timestamps. No additional host collection is enabled.

history.empty: Not enough readings yet. Termix reads the UPS every 30 seconds.

commands.confirmText: This can cut power or change how {{name}} behaves.
commands.needLogin: Add a NUT user and password to this device to send commands.
commands.empty: This UPS has no instant commands.

sources.empty: No UPS set up on this host.
sources.emptyHint: Add a NUT or apcupsd device on this host, or an SNMP card this host can reach.
sources.deleteText: Its history, energy totals, tracking epochs and events are deleted too.

editor.label: Name
editor.nutMissing: upsc is not installed on this host. Install the NUT client first.
editor.nutHint: The name from upsc -l, or name@host:port for a remote NUT server.
editor.apcMissing: apcaccess is not installed on this host. Install apcupsd first.
editor.apcHint: Leave empty to read the daemon on this host, or use host:3551.
editor.snmpMissing: snmpwalk is not installed on this host. Install the net-snmp tools first.
editor.snmpHint: Termix polls the card from this host with snmpwalk.
editor.nutLoginHint: Only needed to send commands. Reading never needs it.
editor.clearSecretsHint: Deletes the saved NUT or SNMP login for this device.
editor.lowChargeHint: Alert when the charge is at or under this while on battery.
editor.lowRuntimeHint: Alert when the runtime left is at or under this while on battery. 0 turns it off.
editor.alertsHint: Power loss, low battery, overload and test problems.
editor.enabledHint: Turn off to stop reading and keep the history.

card.title: UPS
card.empty: No UPS set up. Turn UPS Manager on for a host and add a device.

manager.title: UPS
manager.disabled: UPS Manager is turned off for this host.

enable.label: UPS Manager
enable.description: Read UPS devices from this host and show a UPS tab.

readOnly.label: UPS read only
readOnly.description: Block changes and commands on this host's UPS devices.

use.title: Use UPS Manager
use.description: See UPS status and, with edit access to a host, change devices and send commands.

operations.sourceHint: The UPS id. Leave empty for the first one on the host.

calibrate.title: Calibrate runtime
calibrate.description: Drains the battery to measure its runtime. Hosts on this UPS lose protection while it runs.
